findings.claim: Identity-level source-fenced crosswalk is viable; region-level coverage truth is not.
Computational Possibility provides deep, structured, falsification-tested bounded coverage of a computation subspace without licensing coverage of Mathematics or Computer Science as wholes.

World and Ordivon Normative both deeply map to Philosophy, exposing a MajorRegion navigation defect: Philosophy should not inherit Mind-region semantics merely because it is a non-exclusive member there.
Network and Runtime expose likely normalized-reference omissions around networking/distributed systems and operating/runtime/programming systems; adjacent identities are not sufficient substitutes.
Host may expose either an external-reference omission around workflow/coordination/provenance systems or a genuinely Ordivon-specific structural synthesis; external-source search is required.

The current 7-owner pilot has no direct current-authority mapping to core Physics, Chemistry, Earth/Planetary, Biology or Mind/Cognition/Linguistics identities; this is a pilot finding, not a claim that all Ordivon research is absent there.

Current owner exclusion and untouched reference space are distinct states: SCD/Human/Finance/Media/Harness cannot be scored from this pilot because they lack current Atlas owner publication in the source snapshot.

mappings.scope: Formal regime-relative computational achievability, impossibility, witness/method existence, reductions/transfer, comparative power and abstract constraint/resource structure; does not claim all Computer Science or all computation research.

Reality/actuality and model firewalls; modal claim structure; causal claim/query/grounding/validation; property-evaluation semantics; temporal target-structure; counterfactual and categorial deep research. Does not claim whole Philosophy coverage or domain-specific physical science.

Context-relative constitutive/normative admission, consequence, competence/power and valid transformation semantics; narrower than universal normativity, law, institutions, governance or value theory as a whole.

Qualified cross-locus capability, composition/realization, structural interaction projection, service/satisfaction, reference-resolution and forwarding/reachability realization are mature current Network semantics, but current normalized foundational reference identities lack a clean networking/distributed-systems coordinate.

Execution/runtime operational realization, authority/resource/isolation, interaction/composition, failure/persistence/reconciliation, evidence/truth scope and lifecycle/standing are mature current Runtime semantics; current normalized reference identities lack a clean runtime/operating/programming-systems coordinate.

Durable Task continuity, journal/CAS, revision/lease fencing, bounded handoff/inspection, opaque-extension durability, bounded compatibility and local operational integrity form a mature owner architecture, but no current normalized foundational identity cleanly represents this coordination/continuity object.

Current Game semantic Foundations and practical/game-specific research are real/current, but the bounded foundational Reference World intentionally does not yet contain Game Studies/Game Design/Play as normalized external identities.

next: Externally verify the Philosophy-region and Computing/Systems identity gap candidates using authoritative taxonomies; then repair the reference model before widening owner coverage or adding social/political domains.

nonCoverageCases.case: World physical/reality semantics do not count as Physics coverage
nonCoverageCases.reason: World owner explicitly rejects absorbing domain-specific physical mechanisms.

nonCoverageCases.case: Network adjacency to Information Theory does not count as Information Theory coverage
nonCoverageCases.reason: Network owner explicitly leaves generic information theory external.

nonCoverageCases.case: Runtime adjacency to Computation/Software Engineering does not count as whole-field coverage
nonCoverageCases.reason: Runtime owns execution/operational realization semantics, not generic computation or the software-engineering discipline.

nonCoverageCases.case: Philosophy member mapping under Mind region does not count as Mind/Cognition/Language region coverage
nonCoverageCases.reason: Major-region membership is non-exclusive navigation only.

nonCoverageCases.case: Excluded Human/SCD/Finance/Media/Harness research is not marked untouched
nonCoverageCases.reason: They are outside the current 7-owner authority snapshot; absence of current Atlas publication is not absence of Ordivon research.

referenceModelGapCandidates.claim: Two independent current owners map directly and deeply to norm:philosophy, but Philosophy has no semantically appropriate CanonicalMajorRegion; counting it under Mind/Cognition/Language would be a navigation false positive.
Mature Network semantics lack a clean normalized external coordinate; adjacent computation/information/systems/engineering identities are insufficient.
Mature Runtime semantics lack clean Operating/Runtime/Programming Systems external coordinates.

Host continuity/coordination architecture has only weak adjacent external coordinates; external-source search is required before classifying this as reference-model omission versus Ordivon-novel structure.
norm:philosophy is too coarse to distinguish ethics/normative theory/constitutive normativity from metaphysics/epistemology/mind; deeper Philosophy normalization is required.
